website.reason: 本次变化补齐既有 Apps 的数据管理和卸载闭环，不改变 NextClaw 官网首页的产品定位；双语版本页、App 指南和产品内 Apps 页面已经提供准确入口。

socialPost.text:
NextClaw v0.36.0 is out.

App data now has a real lifecycle: see what each App stores, keep it safely on uninstall, restore it on reinstall, or delete it later with an explicit confirmation.

https://docs.nextclaw.io/en/notes/2026-08-14-nextclaw-v0-36-0
